triggers.name: new_row
triggers.title: New row
triggers.description: New row in a table in Oracle
triggers.help: Triggers when a row is inserted in the selected table. Checks for new rows every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: primary_key
input.label: Unique key
input.hint: Select a unique key column to deduplicate rows. Performance can be improved if the selected unique key is indexed. Learn more

input.name: output_columns
input.label: Output columns
input.hint: Choose columns to be returned from the selected table. Leave blank to return all columns.

input.name: where
input.label: WHERE condition
input.hint: Rows matching this condition will be processed, e.g. currency = 'USD' (enclose strings in single quotes)

triggers.name: new_rows_batch
triggers.title: New rows
triggers.description: New batch of rows in a table in Oracle
triggers.help: Triggers when rows are inserted in the selected table. These rows will be processed in batches. If less rows are available, trigger will deliver as a smaller batch. You can configure the batch size to be any number between 1 and 1000. Default batch size is 100.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

triggers.description: New/updated row in a table in Oracle
triggers.help: Triggers when a row is inserted/updated in the selected table. Checks for new/updated rows every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: primary_key
input.label: Unique key
input.hint: Select a unique key column to deduplicate rows. Performance can be improved if the selected unique key is indexed. Learn more

input.name: sort_column
input.label: Sort column
input.hint: Select a column to identify updated rows. Only timestamp columns can be used as a sort column. Learn more

input.name: output_columns
input.label: Output columns
input.hint: Choose columns to be returned from the selected table. Leave blank to return all columns.

input.name: where
input.label: WHERE condition
input.hint: Rows matching this condition will be processed, e.g. currency = 'USD' (enclose strings in single quotes)

triggers.name: updated_rows_batch
triggers.title: New/updated rows
triggers.description: New/updated batch of rows in a table in Oracle
triggers.help: Triggers when rows are inserted/updated in the selected table. These rows will be processed in batches. If less rows are available, trigger will deliver as a smaller batch. You can configure the batch size to be any number between 1 and 1000. Default batch size is 100.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: table

input.hint: Only the first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

actions.name: delete_rows
actions.title: Delete rows
actions.description: Delete rows in a table in Oracle
actions.help: Delete one or more rows in any table that matches a filter. First select the table, then specify the WHERE condition to filter the row(s) to delete.

input.name: table
input.label: Table
input.hint: Only first 1000 are displayed. Enter name if table is not shown.

input.name: where
input.label: WHERE condition
input.hint: Rows matching this condition will be deleted, e.g. currency = 'USD' (enclose strings in single quotes)

actions.name: execute_procedure
actions.title: Execute stored procedure
actions.help: Executes selected stored procedure with any input parameters provided. Datasets returned from the stored procedure will not be returned as the output of this action.

actions.name: export_csv_v2
actions.title: Export query result
actions.description: Export query result as a CSV file in Oracle
actions.help: This action executes a SQL query and exports the result into a CSV file. This action is intended to write SQL(SELECT) queries.

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL
input.hint: Export the results of this SQL (SELECT) query.

input.name: delimiter
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: The delimiter character that separates each column in the CSV file. CSV files typically use comma .

input.name: target_url
input.label: Upload URL
input.hint: Export the CSV file to this URL. Use the output of Generate on-prem file URL or an S3 presigned URL (with PUT method).

input.label: Return primary keys?
input.hint: Specify whether to return primary keys of inserted rows in the action output. Not returning primary keys can improve performance. Defaults to Yes .

actions.title: Run custom SQL
actions.help: Execute a SQL in Oracle. Provide a valid SQL string and define the expected output fields. This action is intended for write SQL (INSERT and UPDATE) and DDL (CREATE, ALTER and DROP). Maximum number of rows returned in this action is 50000. For SELECT queries, you may use Select rows using custom SQL…

input.label: SQL
input.hint: Provide a valid SQL string to be executed here. Use bind variables, e.g. id = :id , and the parameter field to parameterize inputs.

input.name: update_only
input.label: Execute update only SQL statement without row limit
input.hint: Defaults to No. When Yes, this action imposes no row limits on SQL statements but returns no rows. Use this to do bulk transformations of data.

input.name: parameters
input.label: Parameters
input.hint: First provide the full name assigned to your bind variable in the WHERE condition. e.g. id Second, provide the actual parameter value. Parameter values can be static or datapills. Select the closest c…

actions.name: run_custom_sql_async_v2
actions.title: Run long query using custom SQL
actions.description: Run long query using custom SQL in Oracle
actions.help: Execute a SQL in Oracle asynchronously. Provide a valid SQL string and define the expected output fields. This action is intended to write DML statements (INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE) and DDL statements (CREATE, ALTER and DROP). Query size limit excluding parameters is 1MB. ** For SELECT statements, u…

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL
input.hint: Provide a valid SQL string to be executed here.

input.name: update_only
input.label: Update only query?
input.hint: When Yes, this action will execute the query without returning any rows. Use this to do bulk transformations of data.

input.name: timeout
input.label: Timeout limit (minutes)
input.hint: Set an upper limit for this wait action. If one or more of the async jobs take longer than this, proceed to the next step without waiting. Maximum is 1440 minutes (24 hours).
